findings.title: Vendor bulletin HTTPS accepts any server certificate
findings.evidence: src/HostApplication.Core/InsecureVendorBulletinClient.cs: AcceptAnyServerCertificate returns true only when sslPolicyErrors == SslPolicyErrors.None; Marker TLS_CERTIFICATE_VALIDATED; TC-REG-TLS-CALLBACK rejects invalid chains. inputs/mds2.md MDS2-TLS still documents not met (stale vs main code).

findings.title: Notes stored as plaintext in user AppData
findings.evidence: src/HostApplication.Core/NoteStore.cs writes local UTF-8 notes under ApplicationData; inputs/mds2.md MDS2-DATA met (no PHI, no remote storage). Residual risk is host-account access to the file.

findings.title: No inbound network listener
findings.evidence: No TcpListener/HttpListener/Kestrel or bind usage in workspace/HostApplication; inputs/mds2.md MDS2-NET met; inputs/architecture.md documents outbound-only vendor bulletin GET.

os_kb_advice: Host OS KBs stay a station recommendation and are not in the application zip.
After application TLS validation, host Schannel KBs remain a station-level recommendation and are not included in the self-contained application publish artifact.
